data.one_liner: Splits business logic from views and manages page/animation state in Flutter.
data.what_it_does: Forces a separation between business logic (presenters), view interfaces, and UI pages. It manages page states, animation controllers, and responsive layouts based on device size categories.
use_when: You want to enforce a strict separation between business logic and UI views.
You need built-in support for page animation controllers and responsive device sizing.
avoid_when: You are already using a comprehensive reactive state management solution like BLoC, Riverpod, or Provider and do not need an extra architecture wrapper.
strengths: Clean separation of business logic via presenters and view interfaces.
Built-in handling of animation controllers and multi-animations.
Responsive device sizing context based on standard breakpoint ranges.
weaknesses: Requires adopting a specific architectural pattern and class structure.
Not a reactive state management library on its own.
